title: TCG:SAS-159

objectives.text:
Put Fenris into zone 3. Put the Gleipnir Rope into zone zone 5. 

 There's no blocking in this Mission. Use Solo turn structure. 

 If Fenris is tied up, put the Hammer Mjolnir into zone 5. 

 If a hero has the Hammer Mjolnir, you win.
